question: In June 2025, Startup Accelerator Platform 'WaveX' invited startups to develop an AI-powered real-time multilingual translation solution named _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**BhashaSetu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **June 2025**, the prominent startup accelerator platform **WaveX** launched a specialized challenge for tech entrepreneurs to build **BhashaSetu**, a next-generation translation framework.
 
• **BhashaSetu** is designed as an **AI-powered real-time multilingual translation** solution aimed at eliminating linguistic barriers in professional and social interactions.
 
• The primary objective of this project is to leverage **Artificial Intelligence** and **Machine Learning** to provide instantaneous translation across various **Indian regional languages** and international tongues.
 
• Startups participating in the **WaveX** program are tasked with creating a system that maintains **contextual accuracy** and **cultural nuances** while translating speech and text in real-time.
